writeup: Woot has the Mountain Hardwear Threshold jacket in men's small, black, for $41.99. It's a three-layer DrySpell waterproof shell with pit zips that packs into its own pocket. Vermont Gear sells the same model 2146651 for $200 and Zappos charges $220, so this is about 79% below the cheapest store. Woot caps it at 10 per customer.
